title: Figure 34: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas of the Central Midwest Region
description: Regional map of the US Midwest showing two outlined strategic areas, labeled "Chicago 66 object sightings" and "Dayton 144 object sightings". Each area is linked to a pie chart of evaluation categories (Astro, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown), and a third pie gives the "Balance of Central Midwest Region" (164 object sightings). Caption: "FIGURE 34 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE CENTRAL MIDWEST REGION"; drawing B-7512.
